subject: Re: StrataWave POC — combined credits + trial extension request
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@stratawave.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.w@stratawave.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended POC window + promotional credits + discount for first-year commit

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at StrataWave is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We hit a couple of integration snags during the initial two-week pilot (auth kinks and an embedding mismatch) and would like to request the following as a package to help us get across the finish line:

- Extend the pilot from 14 to 60 days (we need more time to validate production prompts)
- $25,000 in free credits to use during the POC (covering heavy reranking/embedding passes)
- A 20% introductory discount on subscription pricing for the first 12 months if we sign a 12-month commitment by the end of the extended pilot

Attached are the POC metrics we've collected and a draft SOW that outlines expected milestones. Our procurement timeline: if we can agree terms by Aug 20 we can get exec approval the same week.

We appreciate a quick decision — this combo is what will let us move from evaluation to contract.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Data & ML, StrataWave
Attachments: StrataWave_POC_metrics.pdf (pdf), StrataWave_SOW_v1.docx (docx)
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@stratawave.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended POC window + promotional credits + discount for first-year commit

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the metrics. This is a solid opportunity and I think the package is reasonable to get them to a commit, but the combined value (60d + $25k credits + 20% discount) sits outside my approval band.

Grace — looped you for quick approval guidance. Can you confirm if we should escalate to execs for a one-off combined concession? If so, I’ll include the SOW and revenue impact in the summary.

Priya: quick clarifying Qs so we can speed internal review:
- Is the 20% discount expected to apply to usage-based tokens or to the subscription (or both)?
- Can StrataWave commit to a minimum spend floor in year one if we do the discount (e.g., $150k)?

I’ll coordinate internally and get back with a decision by end of day tomorrow.

– Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Fwd: StrataWave POC — combined credits + trial extension request (internal)

Team — forwarding StrataWave's ask. Quick summary and recommendation:

Summary:
- External ask: 60-day pilot extension, $25k promotional credits, 20% first-year discount for a 12-month commit
- Rationale: integration delays; economics show high LTV potential (platform/enterprise expansion)

Our standard on POCs: we can grant a 30-day extension + up to $10k in credits locally. Anything beyond that needs exec/finance signoff.

Recommendation (what I propose we present to execs):
- Approve 60-day extension (risk low; timeline reasonable)
- Approve up to $20k in promotional credits (cap reduces upside risk vs $25k ask)
- Approve up to 18% discount on list for year-one, conditional on a 12-month minimum commit and $150k minimum ARR target in year one

Request: aditya — can you weigh in on discount flexibility? Kimberly — need a quick finance check on revenue impact and whether $20k credit cap + 18% discount is acceptable under current targets. If both OK, I’ll prep a one-page escalation memo for exec approval.

Grace O'Connor
Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

I’m supportive of moving quickly to close this. My notes:

- Credits: OK to approve up to $20k (not the full $25k) provided we get a usage schedule and KPI milestones attached to the SOW (we should be able to claw back overage if milestones not met)
- Discount: we should not commit full 20% without an exec-level sponsor from the customer. I will approve up to 18% for year-one if StrataWave agrees to a 12-month commit and the $150k minimum mentioned by Grace
- Term: 12 months minimum subscription; prefer annual prepay but monthly invoicing with Net30 acceptable if legal signs off

Kimberly — can you do a quick net revenue impact calc vs. our CAC thresholds and confirm? Grace/Marcus — please draft a minimal escalation memo that captures the concession cap, milestones, and suggested contractual language for clawbacks. I can push for exec approval once we have that one-pager + the revised SOW.

- Aditya
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: StrataWave POC — combined credits + trial extension request (final internal approval)

All — ran the numbers. Finance will approve the concession with conditions:

1) Promotional credits: capped at $20,000 (no exceptions). Credits must be timeboxed to the 60-day extension period and audited against the milestones in the SOW.
2) Discount: final approval for 17% off list for year one (I can accept 18% but need a buffer to protect net revenue; 17% is preferred).
3) Minimum commitment: StrataWave must sign a 12-month agreement with a $150k minimum ARR target in year one.
4) Payment terms: Net30; prefer annual prepay but accept scheduled invoicing if legal confirms.
5) Contractual safeguards: include clawback language — if milestones in SOW are not met by the end of the pilot, credits are rescinded pro-rata and discount reverts to list for any subsequent invoice periods until shortfall cured.

Actions for Marcus/Grace: please send the one-page escalation memo + revised SOW (incorporate milestones and clawback language) and ask Priya for explicit confirmation on the $150k floor and billing cadence. Once we have Priya's confirmation and the revised SOW I will sign off and we can route this to execs for notification/signature.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance — Commercial Programs
Redwood Inference
